items.title: 14.12 Hawa ke mayar ke bare mein hypothesis parakhne ke tajurbe aur data jama karna (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 14.12, printed page 317.

blocks.text: Hawa ke mayar ke bare mein hypothesis parakhne ke tajurbe design karne mein mohtaat mansooba-bandi, data jama karna aur tajziya shamil hai.

items: Hypothesis: pehle hypothesis banai jati hai, misal ke taur par 'shehri ilaqon mein hawa ke particulate matter (PM2.5) aur nitrogen dioxide ki concentration peak traffic ke auqat mein non-peak auqat se zyada hai', jise din ke mukhtalif waqton par hawa ke mayar ka data jama kar ke parkha ja sakta hai.
Tajurbe ki design: tafseelat, variables aur data jama karne ke tareeqe samet, mansooba-band ki jati hain; monitoring ke liye masroof sarkon ki jagahein aur rihaishi ilaqe chune jate hain.
Data jama karna: rush aur non-rush auqat mein traffic ke hajm ka data jama aur muqabla kiya jata hai, qabil-e-bharosa aalaat aur tareeqe istemal karte hue.

blocks.prompt: Yeh parakhne ka tajurba design karein ke bhatti ke qareeb PM2.5 hawa ke rukh ke ulat 2 km door gaon se zyada hai ya nahi.
blocks.explanation: Hypothesis: bhatti ke qareeb PM2.5 hawa ke rukh ke ulat jagah se zyada hai. Ek hi oonchai par do jagahein chunein, ek bhatti se 200 m hawa ke rukh par aur ek 2 km ulat; har jagah wahi calibrated nephelometer ya PM sensor istemal karein; do hafte ek hi dinon ke ek hi auqat par namoone lein, hawa ka rukh aur bhatti ke chalne ka record rakhte hue; phir ausaton aur din ba din ke pattern ka muqabla karein.

items: Hawa ke mayar ki hypothesis parakhna: use bayan karein (peak traffic par PM2.5 aur NO2 zyada); design (jagahein, variables, aalaat); data jama karein (rush ke muqable non-rush auqat) aur muqabla karein.
